Featured · Defensive security

ShadowMesh

View ShadowMesh on GitHub

A team project that makes it easier to see what happened during a session on an SSH decoy.

Logging and dashboard

Cowrie logs activity on the decoy server. Python groups the events into sessions and stores them in Elasticsearch. The dashboard shows the events in order and shows how the system responded.

Decoy changes and detection rules

The system can change decoy files based on session activity and draft Snort and YARA rules for review. The running honeypot uses a baseline policy. I explored reinforcement learning separately through offline PPO tests.

My part. I worked with simulated sessions, helped build the decoy-content layer, and contributed to evaluating how the system behaved.

  • Python
  • Cowrie
  • Elasticsearch
  • Docker Compose

Android appKotlin · Bluetooth HID

Controller

An Android phone pairs with macOS as a gamepad. The on-screen controls can be moved and saved for each profile.

Project notes

How it connects

The Android app sends gamepad input to macOS over Bluetooth HID, so the Mac can receive it as controller input. It supports DualSense, Xbox, and Switch Pro layouts. You can move and resize the on-screen controls and save a separate layout for each profile.

Handling button releases

The app limits how often it sends updates to avoid filling the Bluetooth queue. Button releases and sticks returning to center get priority, so the Mac can register when you stop pressing a control.

What makes it practical

The app also has adjustable haptics, so touch controls can give you feedback even when you’re looking at the Mac.

Web appReact · Express · MongoDB

E-Library

A browser library for borrowing and reading books. A companion ML project experiments with book recommendations.

Project notes

Catalog and reading

The app combines a local catalog with external book sources. It tracks borrowing and returns, lets administrators manage the catalog, and remembers where a reader left off in an EPUB.

Book recommendations

A companion Python project uses public Goodreads ratings and matrix factorization to make recommendations. It can suggest titles based on a reader’s ratings or find books with similar rating patterns.

View the recommender on GitHub

Reading tools

The library also has a reading room with a focus timer and ambient sound, alongside the EPUB reader.

Hardware projectArduino · Python · Three.js

ProxiGuard

Distance, infrared, and vibration readings from a physical board, shown next to its 3D model.

Project notes

From the circuit to the browser

An Arduino collects distance, infrared, and vibration readings. An ESP8266 carries the readings over Wi-Fi. A Python gateway forwards them to the browser over WebSockets.

Inspecting the board

The Three.js dashboard places sensor readings alongside a 3D model of the board. It gives you a way to see which sensor is reporting without watching a separate stream of numbers.

Two ways to read the circuit

A small LCD gives feedback at the board. The browser view is for seeing which part of the circuit is reporting and what it is measuring.

Student toolReact · FastAPI · Gemini

Student Compass

Explore a career path and turn it into a short list of skills and resources to start with.

Project notes

Career paths and learning plans

Students can browse a field, compare specializations, and choose a role to explore. Gemini then suggests skills to learn, activities to try, and resources to start with.

Frontend and backend

React handles the browsing and roadmap interface. A FastAPI backend serves career and resource requests and calls Gemini to generate guidance.

The goal was to give students a concrete next step after exploring a career.

Finding reading material

The project also uses Google Books to list resources alongside its guidance.

Media experimentVue · Flask · Librosa

Steganography Pro

A small project on how text and audio behave when you embed and retrieve a message.

Project notes

Text and audio support

The app offers embedding and extraction for text and audio. Vue presents the two workflows. Flask handles the processing, with Librosa used on the audio side.

Capacity and media quality

I used the project to explore how much data each format can hold and how embedding affects media quality or makes a hidden message easier to detect.

What the interface shows

Both workflows let you try embedding and extraction separately, then inspect what came back.
